description: This file contains the PHP source code for the FilterGroup class, which manages filter groups in the OpenCart admin catalog module. It includes methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve filter group data and descriptions from the database.

classes.name: FilterGroup
classes.description: Class responsible for managing filter groups within the OpenCart catalog module. Provides methods to create, read, update, and delete filter group data and associated descriptions.

methods.name: addFilterGroup
methods.description: Adds a new filter group to the database with the specified data, including descriptions in multiple languages. Returns the ID of the newly created filter group.

methods.name: editFilterGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing filter group identified by its ID with new data and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilterGroup
methods.description: Deletes a filter group and its associated descriptions from the database based on the given ID.

methods.name: getFilterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific filter group by ID, including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getFilterGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of filter groups, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a filter group in all available languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter group descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a particular filter group ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter group descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalFilterGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of filter groups in the database.
